notes.title: Blood And Gore + Level travel
notes.notes:
I have added a vast upgrade to the gibbing and bloods system. Its starting to look pretty good. I have a few things to tweak and  need a bit more randomness in the sprays but its coming together.  Added better place holder gibs for the skull fragments. More variation to the AI. 

I also have daisy chained the levels together so you can now get around in either multiplayer or single player.   Lighting improvements on nearly every map.  There is more but its not done however there is a taste in the play test... Come check it out...

notes.title: FPS UPGRADE Maps added.
notes.notes: Just improved the FPS ads transition. Should feel much more realistic. We have added two of the old shooter game maps High Rise and Sanctuary so that should be fun. I was able to recreate all the sound setup so it sounds great. Added a weapon "Deagle". I hope you all enjoy these additions.

notes.title: Perhaps the final iteration of FSP
notes.notes: Much improved FPS movement and ADS settings. Field of view timeline agistments. FPS camera adjustments.

notes.title: ADS Ajustment
notes.notes: These are the Best Raw Ads adjustments I have made thus far. Enjoy

notes.title: ADS Adjustments
notes.notes: I have set the alignment up to better represent True "FPADS". Basically I tinkered with the camera alignment till the ADS lined up with the gun and the player camera. This took three days of adjusting and failing and then this happened.... You should enjoy the experience.

notes.title: Just put up an FPS build.
notes.notes: We are testing the FPS build with droppable items. Hope you get a chance to check it out!
